story: Wekiwa Springs State Park is a 7,000-acre park in Apopka, Florida, located north of Orlando. It contains the head water of the Wekiva River and features a natural spring with crystal clear water and a year-round temperature of 72 °F.
matters: The park shelters rare wildlife, including the Wekiwa hydrobe and the Wekiwa siltsnail, which are endemic to Wekiwa Springs and described as critically imperiled.
name: Wekiwa Springs State Park
